intro.title: Networking fundamentals
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple network diagram to visualize how data travels between devices. You'll learn the core concept of network layers, which organize communication into distinct levels like physical connections and logical addressing. The main technologies involved include IP addresses, routers, and packet switching. By the end, you'll understand how networks are structured and how information moves reliably across the internet.
intro.usecase: Networking fundamentals are the backbone of every modern web application, enabling features like real-time chat in messaging apps, live data updates in financial dashboards, and seamless media streaming in video platforms. As a production engineer, you'll apply these concepts to design resilient systems that handle millions of concurrent connections, optimize data transfer for global e-commerce sites, and troubleshoot latency in user-facing services like online gaming or video conferencing. Mastering these principles ensures you can build scalable, reliable infrastructure that powers everything from social media feeds to cloud-based collaboration tools.
